title: Minuta 2025-03-21
summary: The minutes of the March meeting show all five Council members agreeing that holding the TPM at 5% was the only plausible option, with several stressing that inflation, though in line with forecasts and driven by transitory factors, remained high with relevant risks, and one asking to keep a message of high caution and act firmly if alternative IPoM scenarios materialised. Versus the February minutes, the debate is more two-sided: the earlier text featured a councillor openly raising the possibility of hikes and a stress on two-year expectations, whereas March frames the path as a 'monetary normalisation' that new cost shocks or persistence could merely delay, one councillor noted inflation could fall faster, and some flagged that a substantial global slowdown would require looser policy to avoid a costly overshoot. The minutes therefore reveal a Council somewhat more balanced, and slightly more dovish, than the communique's caution-only wording, with easing still the direction of travel once convergence consolidates.

key_quotes.quote: todos los Consejeros concordaron en que la única opción plausible para esta Reunión era mantener la TPM en 5%
key_quotes.context: Hold was unanimous and no other option was considered

key_quotes.quote: la emergencia de nuevos shocks de costos o la constatación de una mayor persistencia o efectos de segunda vuelta rezagados de shocks anteriores constituirían señales de alerta que podrían llevar a dilatar el proceso de normalización monetaria
key_quotes.context: Risks framed as delaying further easing, not as triggering hikes

key_quotes.quote: algunos Consejeros remarcaron que un debilitamiento sustantivo del crecimiento global pondría un freno a la actividad, generando holguras que podrían llevar a un descenso rápido de la inflación, más allá de la meta, lo cual requeriría una política más laxa
Un Consejero destacó los riesgos respecto de la persistencia inflacionaria, añadiendo que el actual nivel de la inflación era incómodo en caso de potenciales nuevos shocks al alza
